scope: Native sketch local-to-world point placement with batch transport
coverage: 2D and 3D placement in scaled skew basis, default XY and empty batch
Malformed, nonfinite and overflow requests refuse before returning partial geometry
Recovery after refusal and unchanged source arrays
Batch placement integrated with extrusion, loft paths, sweep paths and mesh cutters
limitations: Basis semantics retain existing scale/skew behavior; no orthonormal workplane certification
Other vector computations, frontend semantics and general B-rep completion remain open
